yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!
originRaw := cli.Text("origin", cli.setVerboseName("文本"), cli.setRequired(true))
origin = str.ParseStringToLines(originRaw)

yearRaw := cli.String("year", cli.setVerboseName("年份后缀"), cli.setDefault("1995-2025"))
_ret := str.ParseStringToPorts(yearRaw)
years = make([]string, len(_ret))
for i, result = range years {
    years[i] = sprint(_ret[i])
}


// randomCase := cli.Bool("randomCase", cli.setVerboseName("随机大小写"))



prefix := cli.Text("pass-prefix", cli.setVerboseName("前缀"), cli.setDefault(`web
@`), cli.setRequired(true))
suffix := cli.Text("pass-suffix", cli.setVerboseName("后缀"), cli.setRequired(true), cli.setDefault(`123
!
!@
@
@123
#
#123
_
$
.
123.
1
123
666
888
qwerty
qwe
q1w2e3
666666
888888
*
******
111
111111`))

prefix = str.ParseStringToLines(prefix)
suffix = str.ParseStringToLines(suffix)



filesuffix = cli.Text("filesuffix", cli.setVerboseName("文件后缀"), cli.setDefault(`.txt
.doc
.docx
.xls
.xlsx
.ppt
.pptx
.pdf
.jpg
.jpeg
.png
.gif
.bmp
.mp3
.wav
.mp4
.avi
.mov
.zip
.rar
.7z
.html
.htm
.css
.js
.json
.xml
.sql
.cpp
.c
.java
.py
.rb
.php`))
filesuffix = str.ParseStringToLines(filesuffix)

enablePrefix = cli.Bool("enable-prefix", cli.setRequired(true), cli.setVerboseName("启用前缀"), cli.setDefault(true))
enableSuffix = cli.Bool("enable-suffix", cli.setRequired(true), cli.setVerboseName("启用后缀"), cli.setDefault(true))
enableFileSuffix = cli.Bool("enable-file-suffix", cli.setRequired(true), cli.setVerboseName("文件后缀"))
enableYear = cli.Bool("enable-year", cli.setVerboseName("Year后缀或分隔"), cli.setRequired(true))

enableMon = cli.Bool("month-short", cli.setVerboseName("月份缩写前缀"), cli.setRequired(true))
monthPrefix = make([]string, 48)
for line in str.ParseStringToLines(`Jan
January
Feb
February
Mar
March
Apr
April
May
May
Jun
June
Jul
July
Aug
August
Sep
September
Oct
October
Nov
November
Dec
December`) {
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line)
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line + "@")
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line + "#")
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line.Lower())
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line.Lower() + "@")
    monthPrefix = append(monthPrefix, line.Lower() + "#")
}

cli.check()

rawList = make([][]string)
if enableMon {
    rawList.Push(monthPrefix)
}

if enablePrefix {
    rawList.Push(prefix)
}

if origin.Len() <= 0 {
    origin = ["admin", "root", "administrator"]
}

if origin.Len() > 0 {
    rawList.Push(origin)
}

if enableYear {
    rawList.Push(years)
}

if enableSuffix {
    rawList.Push(suffix)
}

if enableFileSuffix {
    rawList.Push(filesuffix)
}


results, err := dictutil.Mix(rawList...)
die(err)

maxCount = 1
for list in rawList {
    maxCount *= list.Len()
}

yakit.StatusCard("执行状态", "正在生成")

if maxCount>0 {
    yakit.StatusCard("预计字典大小", sprint(maxCount))
}

yakit.EnableText("生成字典")

txt = ""
count = 0
for result in results {
    count++
    txt += str.Join(result, "") + "\n"
    if count % 1000 == 0 {
        yakit.SetProgress(float(count)/float(maxCount))
    }
}
yakit.SetProgress(0.9)
defer yakit.SetProgress(1.0)

yakit.TextTabData("生成字典", txt)
yakit.StatusCard("执行状态", "成功结束")
params: "[{\"Field\":\"origin\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"文本\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"pass-prefix\",\"DefaultValue\":\"web\\n@\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"前缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"pass-suffix\",\"DefaultValue\":\"123\\n!\\n!@\\n@\\n@123\\n#\\n#123\\n_\\n$\\n.\\n123.\\n1\\n123\\n666\\n888\\nqwerty\\nqwe\\nq1w2e3\\n666666\\n888888\\n*\\n******\\n111\\n111111\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"后缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"filesuffix\",\"DefaultValue\":\".txt\\n.doc\\n.docx\\n.xls\\n.xlsx\\n.ppt\\n.pptx\\n.pdf\\n.jpg\\n.jpeg\\n.png\\n.gif\\n.bmp\\n.mp3\\n.wav\\n.mp4\\n.avi\\n.mov\\n.zip\\n.rar\\n.7z\\n.html\\n.htm\\n.css\\n.js\\n.json\\n.xml\\n.sql\\n.cpp\\n.c\\n.java\\n.py\\n.rb\\n.php\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"文件后缀\",\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"year\",\"DefaultValue\":\"1995-2025\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"年份后缀\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"enable-prefix\",\"DefaultValue\":\"true\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"启用前缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"enable-suffix\",\"DefaultValue\":\"true\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"启用后缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"enable-file-suffix\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"文件后缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"enable-year\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"Year后缀或分隔\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"month-short\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"月份缩写前缀\",\"Required\":true,\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"}]"
